sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Prohibits Unison for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 90 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Increases your status ailment success value by 20 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 12000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 12000

[Miraculous Contest] Luis & Vermis or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
